content.theory:
Capstone: combine layout **and** forms into a complete event registration page. This is exactly what real placement-drive pages look like.

### Build it
1. **Header** — event name + date
2. **Description** — a short paragraph
3. **Registration form** with:
   - Full name (text, required)
   - Email (email, required)
   - College (text)
   - Batch year (select with options)
   - Topics of interest (checkboxes)
   - Submit button

### Reference
```html
<form action="/api/register" method="post">
  <label for="fullname">Full name</label>
  <input type="text" id="fullname" name="fullname" required>

  <label for="email">Email</label>
  <input type="email" id="email" name="email" required>

  <label for="year">Batch</label>
  <select id="year" name="year">
    <option value="2026">2026</option>
    <option value="2027">2027</option>
  </select>

  <button type="submit">Register</button>
</form>
```

### Checklist
- Every input has a matching `<label>`
- Every field has a `name`
- Required fields are marked `required`
- The form is wrapped in semantic `<section>`s

exercise.instruction: Build a complete event registration page. Header with the event name 'Hackathon 2026' as an h1. Then a form containing: a required text input named 'fullname' with label 'Full name', a required email input named 'email', a select named 'year' with at least 2 options, and a submit button labelled 'Register'.
hints: Hint 1: Add a required text input: <input type="text" name="fullname" required> with a label.
Hint 2: Add an email input and a <select name="year"> with two <option>s.
